rules: Use this file only to choose what to read next.
Detailed specifications remain in their canonical Markdown pages.
Treat implementation progress separately from specification status.
D3 common system design is complete; do not reopen D3 because D4 individual content data is still missing.
UNTOLD v1 is store-first: App Store / Google Play are the formal product distribution targets; Vercel/Web is for fast development validation, demos, previews, and promotion.
For platform, distribution, Web-demo, or store-release decisions, read platformDistributionStrategy first.
For SNS, promotion requests, Web demos, creator/media previews, pre-release communication, or launch promotion, read promotionStrategy.
For current-milestone or next-step decisions, read currentMilestone.source and parallelMilestone.source before identifying the active design boundary.
P0 is an independent preflight milestone and may advance out of D/A order when doing so reduces high-cost rework.
For P0 continuation, read parallelMilestone.currentStepSource and the completed P0 child pages before reopening an already completed preflight decision.
For application progress, verify implementationProgress and the current untold-game main branch before assigning or completing an A milestone.
For specification-to-implementation, GitHub/Vercel delivery, native validation, interruption recovery, or release readiness, read productionWorkflow instead of relying on a progress snapshot.
For map creation or large map revisions, read mapPreviewWorkflow and then close the work unit through productionWorkflow unless the user explicitly stops before implementation or delivery.
For Web, iPhone native, TestFlight, or release-build test timing, read deviceTestStrategy before deciding whether a milestone requires real-device validation.
For the current P0-3 Web/Safari execution, read deviceTestRunbook after deviceTestStrategy.
For next-step decisions, check decisionInbox, then verify the candidate topic in its canonical source through ai-index.json.
For main story information progression or NET-001 through NET-007 dependency questions, read mainInformationProgression after informationArchitecture.
Follow linked continuation sources to the latest confirmed handoff before proposing a new design decision.
